title: Your Resume Gets Seven Seconds
source: Eye-tracking research on recruiter resume screening
visual_format: I — Apple advertisement, seamless white void

beats.scene: HERO: a single blank matte white sheet of paper floating upright dead centre in the white void, lit softly from above, a thin deep graphite band of light falling across its upper third

beats.change_only: the graphite band across the upper third of the sheet narrows and sharpens

beats.phrase: Recruiters were tracked with eye cameras.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: a slender deep graphite ring floating alone in the white void above a faint contact shadow, tilted slightly toward the viewer

beats.change_only: a single thin graphite line drops from the ring straight down through the empty white space

beats.scene: HERO: a single blank matte white sheet floating upright in the white void with one short graphite bar marked near its top edge

beats.change_only: a second short graphite bar appears directly below the first on the sheet
a third short graphite bar appears below the second on the sheet

beats.scene: HERO: a blank matte white sheet upright in the white void carrying four evenly stacked short graphite bars across its upper third, the lower two thirds completely blank

beats.change_only: the four graphite bars brighten to a deeper graphite while the rest of the sheet stays blank
the lower two thirds of the sheet fades to a paler, almost vanishing white

beats.scene: WIDE: three identical blank matte white sheets floating side by side in the white void, evenly spaced, each with a faint graphite band across its upper third

beats.change_only: the two outer sheets drift slightly further from the centre sheet
the centre sheet tilts a few degrees away from the viewer

beats.scene: HERO: a single blank matte white sheet floating in the white void, its upper third lifted clear of the rest as a separate floating panel with a clean shadow gap between them

beats.change_only: the floating upper panel sinks back down toward the sheet
a dense block of small graphite squares fills the middle of the sheet below the panel

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a blank matte white sheet in the white void crowded with a heavy grid of small graphite squares covering almost its whole surface

beats.change_only: the heavy grid of graphite squares fades to a pale ghost

beats.scene: MEDIUM: three identical slender graphite rings floating in a precise vertical column in the white void, evenly spaced, each casting its own small contact shadow

beats.change_only: the topmost ring fills solid deep graphite
a second blank white sheet slides in behind the column of rings, perfectly aligned

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a single solid deep graphite disc floating beside a blank matte white sheet in the white void, the disc small and precise

beats.change_only: the blank sheet beside the disc shrinks away toward the background

beats.scene: HERO: a blank matte white sheet floating in the white void with one clean rectangular void cut out of its middle, the white background visible through the gap

beats.change_only: the cut rectangle drifts away from the sheet as a separate floating piece

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a blank matte white sheet floating upright in the white void with a single slender graphite ring hovering just in front of its upper third

beats.change_only: a clean matte white panel slides up to cover the lower two thirds of the sheet
the graphite ring in front of the upper third brightens to a deeper graphite

beats.scene: HERO: a completely blank matte white sheet floating alone upright in the white void, nothing marked on it at all, one soft contact shadow below

beats.change_only: a single crisp graphite bar appears across the upper third of the blank sheet

beats.scene: WIDE: two identical blank matte white sheets floating side by side in the white void at the same height, evenly lit, indistinguishable

beats.change_only: the left sheet tilts slightly forward toward the viewer
a dense block of small graphite squares fills the lower half of the right sheet

beats.phrase: The scan is shallow and fast,
beats.scene: MEDIUM: a slender deep graphite ring floating in the white void with a single thin graphite line sweeping horizontally through it

beats.change_only: the horizontal line thickens into a solid graphite band

beats.scene: HERO: a single blank matte white sheet floating upright dead centre in the white void, one bold solid graphite band filling its upper third, the rest pristine and empty

beats.phrase: Spend all of it up top.
beats.change_only: the graphite band across the upper third deepens to near black
